name: Jill Perellies
source: Like Farah, he is an alien. He and the alien faction want Farah back, but Farah has decided to stay with protagonist instead. As a result, he recruits a powerful Earthling girl to help him defeat both of them. However, unlike the protagonist and Farah, he does not form a contract with the girl; instead, he gives her a transforming device.
